C251.notes: SER EU-YU-001. Photo confirmed (no text drip). Value side big 1 · alternating ДИНАР · DINAR · ДИНАР · DINAR · 1984 · beaded rim (SFRY arms / torch-and-wheat obverse not shown). Late Tito-era / early post-Tito brass — tram / kafana / market odd-dinar while Cyrillic and Latin still shared every coin. Country #43 — first Yugoslavia in the vault; Balkans after Greece C245/C248. Twin keep: C262 / EU-YU-002. Yugoslavia flips now 2.
C251.story: A 1984 1 dinar from Yugoslavia. The obverse shows SFRY arms (torch and wheat); the reverse shows big 1; bilingual ДИНАР / DINAR legend, date, beaded rim. Struck in brass.
